chain.label: Insufficient torque applied to cylinder hold-down nuts during undocumented maintenance
chain.trigger: resulted from the application of insufficient torque, which was applied by Air Sunshine maintenance personnel during undocumented maintenance

chain.label: Pilot's history of below-average flight proficiency
chain.trigger: the pilot had a history of below-average flight proficiency, including numerous failed flight tests

chain.label: No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts loosened and backed off their studs
chain.trigger: two or more of the right engine No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts became loose and backed off of the studs

caused_by.evidence: an outside influence, such as the application of insufficient torque to the nuts during maintenance, likely occurred

chain.label: Remaining cylinder studs and through bolts fractured in high-stress fatigue
chain.trigger: the remaining studs and through bolts fracturing in high-stress fatigue, allowing the cylinder to separate from the engine

caused_by.evidence: The loss of the cylinder hold-down nuts on the two unfractured studs would have caused the loads to be transferred to the remaining studs and through bolts. The increased load would have been sufficient to initiate and propagate high-stress fatigue fractures

chain.label: Right engine failed in flight
chain.trigger: he heard a bang and saw oil coming out of the right engine cowling

caused_by.evidence: the No. 2 cylinder was found separated from the engine crankcase at the cylinder flange. Therefore, the Safety Board concludes that the airplane's right engine failed

chain.label: Pilot failed to adequately manage single-engine airplane performance
chain.trigger: not flying at the recommended airspeeds and flap settings, operating with a bank angle and sideslip that were not in accordance with Cessna's recommended in-flight engine failure configuration, and not maintaining a steady descent

caused_by.evidence: Other factors that were most likely caused or controlled by the pilot...could have degraded the accident airplane's performance
which contributed to his inability to maintain maximum flight performance and reach land after the right engine failed

chain.label: Pilot failed to conduct required emergency ditching briefing
chain.trigger: the pilot failed to conduct an emergency briefing, which was required by the emergency ditching procedures contained in Air Sunshine's General Operations Manual

caused_by.evidence: passengers reported that, after the right engine failed, the pilot did not tell them to retrieve or don their PFDs before the airplane contacted the water

chain.label: Airplane ditched in the Atlantic Ocean
chain.trigger: flight 527...was ditched in the Atlantic Ocean about 7.35 nautical miles west-northwest of Treasure Cay Airport

caused_by.evidence: he realized the airplane could not make it to the airport and that he would have to ditch the airplane
if the average descent rate had been about 200 fpm or less, the airplane would have been able to maintain flight and reach MYAT

chain.label: Passenger fatalities after evacuation into the water
chain.trigger: one adult and one child passenger died after they evacuated the airplane

caused_by.evidence: Passengers reported that the airplane sank within several minutes after contacting the water
this failure contributed to passenger fatalities
